definition: D03 treatment contract. Non-resume operations retain the default-safe statement budgets. Resume is excluded here because its blocking contract is a paired, sample-by-sample exact +5 completed-statement delta against a same-build resume_deltas=false control artifact that exercises one changed checkpoint source. The delta is authenticated context validation, context setup, timeout setup, one batched version-pair SELECT, and COMMIT.

baseline.method: Pair the treatment with a passing definitive 640K resume_deltas=false control through --resume-control-from. Both arms must pass --exercise-resume-delta-fixture, which checkpoints and then mutates the same source. The D03 gate requires at least 30 paired samples, exactly +5 completed SQL statements per treatment resume for one batched application SELECT plus authenticated transaction overhead, and treatment resume p95 no greater than 150ms.

open.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

search.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

write.fixture: One new, single-chunk Markdown entry with semantic work queued.

checkpoint.variability: The baseline checkpoint has no explicit source_refs; the bounded 64-source probe is reported separately.
